svg.text: A sandbox is a budget, not a permission
The human moves a capped sum into a budget once. Inside it the agent spends without asking; outside it nothing changes.
pooled mode: a ceiling, no transfer
costs the PIN and the passphrase
and every spend as a receipt
WALLETD — ONE CHECK ON EVERY SPEND
in this order; the first refusal wins
refused — but a sweep home still works
the agent's profile is not this budget's
the fee comes out of the same budget
the clock starts at creation, not at funding
a human must approve THIS destination
no PIN, no approval — the money is the bound
any payee only when the operator
armed it unattended, or the payee
the approval card is built from the
sealed row, never from the request
an unknown sandbox id is refused,
never the keys, never the seal,
none of this is the agent being good:
walletd refuses, and the agent gets a code back.
The seal is what makes a confirmation honest
Every row in sandboxes.json carries a seal. If the address, the arm or the allowlist is edited outside the wallet, the row reads tampered
and every spend is refused — the leftover can still be swept home, because that destination comes from the seed, not from the row.
